summary: Search signals this week lean toward home and desk electronics (portable monitors, label printers, mini rice cookers, floor beds), a handful of skincare and oral-care ingredients (nano-hydroxyapatite, hypochlorous acid, peptides), and Q4 gift items. China-origin duty is now MFN + legacy Section 301 + a 12.5% Section 301 forced-labor tariff effective July 24, 2026; IEEPA tariffs were reported struck down in Feb 2026. Evidence is thin: Amazon and Reddit could not be fetched, and most unit costs are Alibaba listing ranges or my own estimates.
changes_vs_last_run: The 2026-11-02 run had zero survivors (every candidate failed the margin or $40-per-customer screen) and I did not re-research those items. This run uses mostly new candidates: label printer, portable monitor, mini rice cooker, travel dryer bundle, power bank, bidet kit, acoustic panels, magnetic shelf, foam sprayer kit, floor mattresses, nHA toothpaste, hypochlorous spray, peptide eye cream, collagen powder, litter box, bidet seat, cordless vacuum, neck massager, mini projector, water filter, padel set, draped skirt, heated throw, Japandi lamp, label rolls. Score moves vs last run cannot be claimed. Three kills carried forward as a policy list.

candidates.name: Bluetooth/USB 4x6 thermal shipping label printer (110mm), with starter label roll
candidates.angle: Ship a printer with reliable pairing, a one-page setup guide and bundled labels against Rollo/Munbyn/Nelko.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 (radio) certification for the Bluetooth/Wi-Fi module; UL/ETL for the power adapter. If it has a lithium battery, UN38.3 and shipping rules apply.
candidates.notes: Retail from affiliate roundups (Rollo ~$122, Munbyn $179, Nelko ~$70). Alibaba tiers: ~$45 at 500+, ~$34 for a cheaper model; I used $40. Duty assumes MFN free + 25% Section 301 + 12.5% forced-labor; aggregator pages disagree (one shows 17.5% total), so 0.375 is conservative. Fee, CPC and CVR are benchmarks. Medium-low confidence.

candidates.name: 15.6-inch 1080p USB-C portable monitor with magnetic cover stand
fixable_complaints: USB-C port lacks DisplayPort Alt Mode compatibility
candidates.angle: Include a compatibility checker, a mini-HDMI cable, a sturdier stand and brighter panel.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 declaration of conformity; ENERGY STAR not required. No battery, so no lithium rules.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics shows 6,600 searches/mo, +838%. Alibaba 100-piece listings run $39-57; I used $50. Branded AOC units retail at ~$195-200, so $119 is a guess at mid-market. Duty assumption conservative (monitors may be lower).

candidates.name: 1L mini rice cooker with steam tray, non-stick pot
candidates.angle: Offer a 1.5L PFAS-free ceramic coating with a bundled steamer and clear dorm/solo-cook positioning.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL/ETL listing needed for Amazon electrical appliances; food-contact materials (FDA) compliance; PFAS-free claims must be substantiated.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 33,100 searches/mo, +438%. Alibaba: $8.80 (1.2L, MOQ 500), $19.59 (1L, MOQ 300 on Made-in-China); I used $15. Duty: sources conflict on the HTS line (8516.79 free vs 8516.60); 0.375 assumes a 25% 301 line. Price is estimated. Sits right on the $40 threshold.

candidates.name: Foldable ionic travel hair dryer with diffuser and storage pouch
candidates.angle: Pair a dual-voltage 1600W motor with a diffuser, bundled as a gift set.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL listing (UL 859/1727) and CPSC rules; FCC not needed for a plain heater.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: only 3,600 searches/mo (+223%), so demand is small. Alibaba: $2.85-$3.10 (1,000 MOQ, likely weak), $6.65 at 10+, $8.00-9.00 for 2000W ionic with diffuser; I used $9.50. MFN 3.9% per aggregators; Section 301 list unverified; I assumed 25%.

candidates.name: 20,000mAh 45W power bank with built-in USB-C cable and display
candidates.angle: Hard to beat Anker/Baseus on price; only win with verified true capacity and a replaceable cable.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UN38.3 test summary, FCC SDoC, UL 2056 or equivalent; lithium batteries must ship as ground/DG-compliant (Amazon requires dangerous goods review).
candidates.notes: Alibaba: $9-11.50 for 45W with cable at MOQ 500; I used $10. Duty 3.4% MFN + 25% Section 301 (Jan 2026 increase) + 12.5% = 40.9%. Dominated by big brands, so low competition score. Price is at the $40 floor. Low confidence it is worth pursuing.

candidates.name: Non-electric dual-nozzle bidet attachment plus handheld travel bidet kit
candidates.angle: Brass fittings, a universal adapter kit and a leak-proof guarantee.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Plumbing: NSF/ANSI 61 or lead-free (Reduction of Lead in Drinking Water Act) compliance for fittings; CPC listing may be requested by some retailers.
candidates.notes: Alibaba: $9.90-17.90 (200-set MOQ), and $9.80 on Global Sources (100 MOQ). I used $13 for a two-item kit. Smart bidet searches up +750% (1,900/mo). Duty is a guess (plastics/valves under 8481 or 3922) at 25% Section 301 + 12.5% + small MFN.

candidates.name: Self-adhesive PET felt acoustic wall panels, 24-pack 12x12 in
candidates.angle: Offer designer colors, an adhesive that works on painted walls, and a flame-rated certificate.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Fire-safety claims need ASTM E84 testing; California TB117 or Prop 65 considerations; no special agency approval otherwise.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 135,000 searches/mo, +191%. Pricing is the weakest part: a 12-pack felt at $7.80-8.90 on a mirror site is unverified, Walmart 12-pack retail $26.99, and a CBP ruling says polyester nonwoven acoustic panel from China carries 25% Section 301. Unit cost $16 for 24 pieces is my conservative guess.

candidates.name: Magnetic wall/fridge shelf, 2-pack with steel mounting plates
candidates.angle: Use stronger magnets rated and tested for stated load, with a wall-mount plate.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Strong magnets: some shipping restrictions for air freight; otherwise none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 6,600/mo, +983%. I could not identify exactly what 'magnetic shelf' means in that data; I assumed kitchen/fridge shelves. Retail $17-47 from Walmart snippets. Unit cost is a pure estimate with no supplier quote. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Car wash foam sprayer kit: 2L pump foamer, 2 microfiber mitts, soap sample
candidates.angle: Bundle a better brass nozzle and gasket with mitts so it reads as a complete kit.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Soap sample: check state VOC/chemical rules; otherwise none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics 'foam sprayer' 49,500/mo, +176%. Alibaba: 2L pump sprayer $1.27-1.38 at 3,000 MOQ (too high an MOQ), 1-piece lances $6-8. My $9 includes mitts. Seasonal (spring). Low-medium confidence.

candidates.name: Japanese-style shiki floor futon mattress, twin, removable washable cover
fixable_complaints: too expensive for what it is
candidates.angle: Thicker, evenly filled mattress with a zipper cover and carry strap.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Mattresses: 16 CFR 1632/1633 flammability testing; state law labeling (law label), bedding registration in some states (e.g., California, Pennsylvania).
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 22,200/mo, +479%. Review complaints from J-Life, MIINA (~$158) and Native Nest pages. Unit cost is my estimate (no quote found). Duty guessed as ~6% MFN + 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%. Bulky; freight and fulfillment estimates are rough.

candidates.name: Tri-fold foam floor bed, twin, with washable cover
candidates.angle: Use CertiPUR-US foam with a non-slip cover aimed at guest rooms and kids.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Mattress flammability (16 CFR 1633 / 1632), state law labels; CertiPUR-US is optional.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics 'twin floor bed' 9,900/mo, +670%; hypersku/Exploding list price $20-85. Costs are my estimates, not quotes. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Fluoride-free nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste, 3-pack of 3.4 oz tubes
candidates.angle: Smooth 10% nHA formula in a 3-pack with a refill-by-mail option, compared against Boka/Apagard.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Fluoride-free toothpaste is generally a cosmetic: MoCRA facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation, ingredient labeling, adverse event reporting. Do not claim to treat or prevent cavities or remineralize enamel (drug claims). Fluoride versions are OTC drugs.
candidates.notes: 5-year search growth +6,200% (Exploding Topics). Supplier listings show $0.26-0.70 per tube (MOQ 72-10,000), but those are bare tubes; I used $2.50 per tube for a contract-made, boxed product. 1.8 orders/yr is a guess; a tube lasts ~6 weeks. Duty guess is 7.5% List 4A + 12.5%.

candidates.name: Hypochlorous acid face and body spray 2-pack, 3.4 oz
candidates.angle: Opaque, stable bottle with a dated expiry and cosmetic-only positioning.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA (facility registration, product listing, safety substantiation). Avoid 'treats acne/eczema' (drug) and 'disinfects/kills germs' (EPA pesticide registration under FIFRA). Amazon beauty may ask for documents.
candidates.notes: 5-year search growth +8,900% (Exploding Topics). Ulta comp: $27 per 4 oz. Private-label sources: Pravada MOQ 50-250; Alibaba-sourced listings $0.65-1.06/unit but unverified. I used $3 per unit contract-made in the US and 0% duty (US fill; imported components not included). Orders/year guess.

candidates.name: Peptide eye cream, 0.5 oz, 2-pack
candidates.angle: Airless pump, fragrance-free formula, 2-pack sized for 3 months.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA: facility registration and product listing, safety substantiation, label ingredients. No claims to repair collagen or treat wrinkles at a structural level (drug claims). Expect Amazon beauty gating.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 6,600/mo, +325%. Private-label quotes conflict: $2.40-4.80 at 500u in one guide vs $4-22 in another; I used $6 per jar x2. Orders/yr 1.8 is a guess. Heavily competed by established brands.

candidates.name: Collagen protein powder, unflavored or vanilla, 30 servings, US-made
candidates.angle: Third-party tested, clean-label flavors with a transparent amino panel.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement: cGMP (21 CFR 111), Supplement Facts panel, no disease claims, FDA facility registration, adverse event reporting; Amazon requires supplement category approval and third-party testing.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 22,200/mo, +242%. No supplier quote found; my $12 cost is an estimate. Dominated by Vital Proteins, Ancient Nutrients etc., which I have not checked. Prior run's gummy supplements all failed the margin screen.

candidates.name: Self-cleaning automatic cat litter box
candidates.angle: Hard to beat Litter-Robot/Petlibro; only a sensor-reliable, low-noise version for under $170.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15, UL/ETL for the power supply; app privacy terms.
candidates.notes: hypersku says self-cleaning litter box earned ~$13M on TikTok Shop in Q4 2025. Cost, freight and fulfillment are my estimates with no quote. Duty assumes the 25% line + 12.5%. Returns will be high; I did not model them.

candidates.name: Electric heated bidet toilet seat with warm water, 2 nozzles
candidates.angle: Remote with clear install video and a free fit guide for round and elongated bowls.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL 1431 listing, FCC; water-contact parts NSF/ANSI 61; installation instruction requirements.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: smart bidet 1,900/mo, +750% (small base). Alibaba seller blog has MOQ guidance but I did not extract a price. Cost estimate has no quote. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Lightweight cordless stick vacuum with 2 batteries
candidates.angle: Second swappable battery and washable filter at a sub-$120 price.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Lithium battery UN38.3 and dangerous goods shipping; UL 1017/2595; FCC for motor control; battery recycling labelling in some states.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 135,000/mo, +492%. Competition (Shark, Dyson, Tineco) is heavy. Cost is a guess; duty uses the power-bank battery line as a proxy. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Rechargeable neck and shoulder massager with heat
candidates.angle: Stronger motors, longer battery and a clearer sizing guide.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC; UN38.3 battery; FDA general wellness wording only (no pain-relief or treatment claims, or it becomes a device).
candidates.notes: Appears in the hypersku BFCM TikTok list and Google holiday data covers home spa; no price or cost data was found, so cost is my estimate. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Portable mini projector, 1080p supported, with tripod
candidates.angle: Honest lumen and resolution specs with a built-in streaming stick.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15; UL for power; honest lumen/resolution advertising (FTC); Amazon may restrict claims.
candidates.notes: Google's Holiday 100 reported 'movie projector' searches up 945% in 2025 and home projectors up 60%. That is last year's data; I found no 2026 list. Cost is an estimate. Heavy competition from Wanbo, Yaber, and others.

candidates.name: Under-sink or countertop microplastic-reducing water filter
candidates.angle: Certified claims plus a cartridge subscription with a clear replacement interval.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Contaminant-reduction claims need NSF/ANSI 42/53/401 or P473 certification; unverified claims risk FTC and state action; California requires registration for water treatment devices.
candidates.notes: 5-year search growth +6,100% (Exploding Topics), $25-500 price range. Cost and repeat rate are estimates. Strong brands (Brita, Waterdrop, Aquasana). Low confidence.

candidates.name: Padel starter set: 2 rackets, 3 balls, bag
candidates.angle: Beginner-friendly carbon-fibre rackets with spare grips and a guide.
candidates.regulatory_notes: none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Padel balls 5-year search growth +2,125%; Alibaba reported US pickleball orders +197% in March 2025. I found no cost quotes; $24 is my estimate. Padel is small in the US.

candidates.name: Draped-front midi skirt in satin, sizes XS-XL
candidates.angle: Lined, true-to-size fabric with a size chart tested on real customers.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile fiber content labeling (FTC Textile Act), care labels, country-of-origin marking; flammability (16 CFR 1610) is generally fine.
candidates.notes: Exploding Topics: 5,400/mo, +1,567% (a fashion trend that may fade; trend score reflects that). Duty guess: ~16% MFN on synthetic apparel + 7.5% list + 12.5%, roughly 0.35 (not verified). Cost is a guess. Apparel return rates are high and I did not model them.

candidates.name: Electric heated throw blanket, 50x60 in, auto shut-off
candidates.angle: Dual-zone heating with a machine-washable fleece and 10-year-safe controller.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UL 964 listing, CPSC rules for electric blankets; labelling of washing instructions; textile labeling.
candidates.notes: Google's Holiday 100 mentions heated blankets rising in 2025; wearable blanket hoodies failed margin last week. Seasonal (Q4). Cost and duty are estimates. Quite competitive (Sunbeam, Bedsure).

candidates.name: Cordless rechargeable Japandi-style table lamp, touch dimmer
candidates.angle: Weighted ceramic or wood base with 20-hour battery and warm dimming.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC for LED driver if electronic; UN38.3 and Amazon battery review; lighting listings often require UL/ETL.
candidates.notes: Japandi lamp 5-year search growth +3,800% at $40-400+ (Exploding Topics). Cost, duty and CPC are guesses. Many sellers.

candidates.name: 4x6 direct thermal shipping label rolls, 6 rolls x 500 labels
candidates.angle: Pair with the printer as a repeat-purchase consumable with a subscribe option.
candidates.regulatory_notes: none beyond standard rules.
candidates.notes: Alibaba roll prices $2.73-3.50 per roll (the only sourced cost here); 6 x $3.10 = $18.60. Heavy; fulfillment fee is a guess. 2 orders/year assumes active sellers. Likely thin margin.
